items.exampleEn: Please get in touch if you have any questions.
items.exampleZh: 如果你有任何問題，請跟我們聯絡。

items.exampleEn: The two players had an argument during the game.
items.exampleZh: 那兩個球員在比賽中吵了一架。

items.exampleEn: I keep in touch with my old classmates online.
items.exampleZh: 我在網路上和老同學保持聯絡。

items.exampleEn: My uncle kept a promise he made to his son.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔遵守了他對兒子許下的承諾。

items.exampleEn: Bears lose weight during the long winter.
items.exampleZh: 熊在漫長的冬天裡體重會減輕。

items.exampleEn: Our class made progress in English this year.
items.exampleZh: 我們班今年英文進步了。

items.exampleEn: I need more time to make a decision.
items.exampleZh: 我需要更多時間來做決定。

items.sentenceEn: You can get in touch with me by phone or email.
items.sentenceZh: 你可以打電話或寫電子郵件跟我聯絡。

items.audioEn: We can't make a decision until we see the price.
items.audioZh: 我們要看到價格才能做決定。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼還不能決定？
options: They need to know the cost first
Their boss is not in the office

items.sentenceEn: I had an argument with my sister about the bathroom.
items.sentenceZh: 我和我的姊妹為了浴室的事吵了一架。

items.sentenceEn: Is it hard for you to keep a promise to a friend?
items.sentenceZh: 對你來說，遵守對朋友的承諾很難嗎？

items.stemEn: By Friday, our team has to ____: the red one or the blue one?
items.stemZh: 星期五之前，我們團隊得做決定：選紅色的還是藍色的？

items.stemEn: After she moved to Canada, we ____ by email.
items.stemZh: 她搬到加拿大以後，我們靠電子郵件保持聯絡。

items.passageEn: When Kai started university, he made a decision to learn to swim. He was slow, but he made progress every week. He also lost weight, so his old jeans became too big. One day he had an argument with Ben, the classmate who shared his room, about the noise at night. Later they said sorry to each other. It turned out that they liked the same music, and they became good friends. Now they live in different cities, but Ben gets in touch every month.
items.passageZh: Kai 上大學時，決定要學游泳。他學得很慢，但每週都有進步。他也瘦了，所以舊牛仔褲變得太大。有一天，他和同寢室的同學 Ben 為了晚上的噪音吵了一架。後來他們互相道歉。結果發現他們喜歡同樣的音樂，就成了好朋友。現在他們住在不同的城市，但 Ben 每個月都會跟他聯絡。

questions.questionZh: Kai 的舊牛仔褲為什麼變得太大？
Kai 和 Ben 為什麼吵架？

items.promptZh: 我們搬到鄉下以後，我的貓瘦了。
referenceEn: My cat lost weight after we moved to the countryside.
After we moved to the countryside, my cat lost weight.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 lost weight 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 got thinner、became thinner 等）也算對
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 lost weight、has lost weight 等）

items.promptZh: 我妹妹的鋼琴一直在進步。
referenceEn: My sister is making progress with the piano.
My younger sister keeps making progress with the piano.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 is making progress 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 is getting better at、is improving 等）也算對
「一直在」可用進行式或 keep＋V-ing（例如 is making progress、keeps improving 等）
「鋼琴」可寫，例如 with the piano、at the piano、in piano 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員：always keeps a promise 不道地（片語表照原字須保留 a promise，改寫成特定承諾＋關係子句）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "My uncle kept a promise he made to his son."（原 "My uncle always keeps a promise."）
改為 "我叔叔遵守了他對兒子許下的承諾。"（原 "我叔叔總是遵守承諾。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員：Dad kept a promise 講特定承諾不道地；改寫並與片語卡情境、句型區隔
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Is it hard for you to keep a promise to a friend?"（原 "Dad kept a promise and took us to the beach."）
改為 "對你來說，遵守對朋友的承諾很難嗎？"（原 "爸爸遵守承諾，帶我們去了海邊。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員：例句是「進展」義，不是第一義「進步」

改為 "我們班今年英文進步了。"（原 "我們今天在新計畫上有了進展。"）
